summary.text: Frank Conaway is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 40 in Baltimore City, first elected in 2006 and a member since 2007. His official page lists him on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Conaway's official page says he was born in Baltimore in 1963 and graduated from Northwestern High School.
It lists study at Howard University and Morgan State University and a B.A. in business administration from Sojourner-Douglass College in 1999.

It lists earlier work including owning an insurance company, working as a sales consultant at the Avant Garde Travel Agency from 1992 to 2005, and working as a chauffeur for the Baltimore municipal post office from 2005 to 2014.
The page lists his assignments as the Judiciary Committee and its Civil, Criminal and Juvenile subcommittees, the Joint Committee on Protocol and the Legislative Black Caucus of Maryland.
